# =============================================================================
# MiStudio Backend Requirements
# =============================================================================
# THE RULE (D31, 2026-10-17): SHIP WHAT IS TESTED.
#   * This file names what the backend depends on directly.
#   * constraints.txt (GENERATED by scripts/lock_constraints.py from the dev venv)
#     pins every package of the resolved set that this file does not pin with ==.
#   * The Dockerfile and CI install `-r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt`, so
#     the image resolves exactly the versions the test suite ran on.
#   * tests/unit/test_pinned_versions_match_the_venv.py fails when this file,
#     constraints.txt and the venv disagree, or when the closure gains a package
#     constraints.txt does not cover.
#   To move a version: install it in backend/venv, run the suite, then
#   `venv/bin/python scripts/lock_constraints.py`, and commit both files.
#   (On 2026-10-17 the image ran mcp 1.12.4, fastapi 0.143.3 and 24 other versions
#   no test had exercised, because ranges and transitives resolved at build time.)
#
# History - Updated 2025-12-16
# =============================================================================
# Phase 2 Update: 47 packages updated (21 PATCH + 26 safe MINOR)
#
# 2026-10-22 (deps sync): EVERY entry below, deferred or coupled, is now at the latest release
# (operator: every app on the latest release), or held with its cause beside its pin.
# See 0xcc/reviews/deps_sync_2026-10-21.md.
#
# DEFERRED TO PHASE 3 (Major version bumps requiring testing):
# - datasets: DONE 2026-10-17 → 5.0.1 (security; with fsspec 2026.6.0)
# - redis: 5.3.1 → 7.1.0 (major version, async API changes)
# - pytest: 7.4.4 → 9.0.2 (major version, test framework changes)
# - pytest-asyncio: 0.21.2 → 1.3.0 (major API changes)
# - pytest-cov: 4.1.0 → 7.0.0 (major version)
# - aiofiles: 23.2.1 → 25.1.0 (major version)
# - python-json-logger: 2.0.7 → 4.0.0 (major version)
# - tenacity: 8.5.0 → 9.1.2 (major version)
# - ipython: 8.37.0 → 9.8.0 (major version)
# - pyarrow: 21.0.0 → 22.0.0 (major version)
# - fsspec: DONE 2026-10-17 → 2026.6.0 (security)
#
# DEFERRED - TIGHTLY COUPLED (update together):
# - fastapi: 0.104.1 → 0.124.4 (20 minor versions jump)
# - starlette: 0.27.0 → 0.50.0 (23 minor versions jump)
# - uvicorn: 0.24.0 → 0.38.0 (14 minor versions jump)
# - ruff: 0.1.15 → 0.14.9 (13 minor versions jump)
#
# REMOVED - MANAGED BY TORCH (no longer pinned):
# - nvidia-* packages are installed automatically by torch as dependencies
# - Pinning them causes version conflicts when torch is updated
#
# REMOVED 2026-10-08 - POETRY AND ITS TREE (never imported by the app):
# - poetry, poetry-core and 24 packages present only as its dependencies
#   (dulwich, virtualenv, keyring, cleo, CacheControl, ...) had been frozen in
#   from a dev venv and shipped in the image for nothing. Nothing in src/,
#   tests/, alembic/ or scripts/ imports them; the Dockerfile and CI install
#   from this file with pip. Kept: shellingham (typer), filelock and
#   platformdirs (torch/hf/black).
#
# =============================================================================

# MCP server for agentic access (Feature 010)
# mcp 2.x since 2026-10-22 (deps sync, operator: every app on the latest release). 2.x renamed
# FastMCP to MCPServer (mcp.server.mcpserver), moved the streamable-HTTP options (stateless,
# JSON responses, body limit, host) from the constructor to `streamable_http_app`, made the
# mcp.types fields snake_case, and passes an exception's text to the agent only for ToolError
# (BackendError is one: test_mcp_errors_reach_the_agent.py). miLLM installs mcp only for its
# contract test and pins whatever this line pins; the two move in one push window.
# EXACT since 2026-10-17 (operator: ship what's tested); test_pinned_versions_match_the_venv.py
# fails if the venv and this pin drift.
